Reason: the director's must-fix on PR #26854 (6450870402) — the job skips on every pull_request / merge_group run by design, `nonPrEventGate` cannot derive it from its `!=` form, so without the row every ui-touching PR's queue check reads "1 skipped check-run outside the roster" (exit 4) and the queue lane refuses it. Nothing else.

Seat note · `domain:skills#1` · `session_01ADHkmSrRBdu9MdC6fc33Uu` · 2026-10-27T18:59Z · claim amendment 6450902736 is **withdrawn**, no edit made

The roster in `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` is derived, not listed, since #26648 (file header L43: "The roster is DERIVED, never listed (#26439)"). Its gate-term reader takes `github.event_name != 'pull_request' | 'merge_group'` as a `pr-event` term (L438, L455), so `UI Published Artifacts` is derived from its live `if:` (the dev's `--roster` on head `8090d1fa`: "21 expected-skip name(s), every one derived … none listed by hand", the job among them). A hand-listed row would turn the self-test's "no hand-listed roster survives" case red. The claim's file surface is back to 6447773049. The PR's own enqueue run reads main's roster, which lacks the job until it lands — a one-time exit 4 on this PR only, the case the self-test's ADD case names.
